_설명: 완성 4과 수동태 — 보기 순서만 섞여 있던 객관식을 손으로 새로 썼다. 묻는 것과 푸는 방법은 그대로 두고 문장과 보기를 바꿨다. 긴 지문 문항(종합1 32번)은 지문을 새로 쓸 수 없어 틀린 자리를 옮겼다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장을 영작한 것으로 올바른 것은?
body: 그 아이들은 수년 동안 그 단체에 의해 보살핌을 받아왔다.
choices: The children have cared for the group for years.
The group has cared by the children for years.
The children was cared for by the group for years.
The children have cared for by the group for years.
The children have been cared for by the group for years.
문항.explanation: 현재완료 수동태는 「have been + 과거분사」로 쓰며 care for의 for를 빠뜨리지 않는다.

문항.prompt: 다음 주어진 문장을 수동태로 올바르게 전환한 것은?
body: <보기> The news made the fans very excited.
choices: The fans were very excited by the news.
The fans made very excited by the news.
The fans are made very excited by the news.
The fans were made very excited by the news.
The news has been made very excited by the news.
문항.explanation: 목적어를 주어로 보내고 「was made + 목적격보어」의 형태로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장을 영작한 것으로 올바른 것은?
body: 그들은 그녀에 의해 그 방을 떠나는 것이 목격되었다.
choices: They saw her leave the room.
They saw to leave the room by her.
She was seen to leave the room by them.
They are seen leaving the room by her.
They were seen to leave the room by her.
문항.explanation: 목격된 쪽이 They이므로 They를 주어로 하고 목적격보어는 to부정사로 바뀐다.

문항.prompt: 주어진 문장의 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 바꾸어 쓴 것은?
body: <보기> For many years, it [[believes]] that eating
carrots is good for the eyes.
choices: believed
will believe
has believed
will be believed
has been believed
문항.explanation: 오랫동안 그렇게 믿어져 왔다는 뜻이므로 현재완료 수동태로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 주어진 문장에서 [[틀린]]부분을 찾아 올바르게고친 것은?
body: <보기> Health Authority ⓐ [[warns]] that medicines
ⓑ [[can]] lose their effect, ⓒ [[even if]] ⓓ [[they]] ⓔ
[[store]] in a cool place.
choices: ⓐ was warned
ⓑ cannot
ⓒ as if
ⓓ it
ⓔ are stored
문항.explanation: 약은 보관되는 쪽이므로 수동태 are stored로 써야 한다.

문항.prompt: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 [[틀린]]것은?
body: The desire for fame has its roots in the
experience of neglect. No one would want to be
famous who hadn’t also, somewhere in the past,
been made
choices: [[to feel]] extremely insignificant. We sense the need for a great deal of admiring attention when we have been painfully exposed to earlier deprivation. Perhaps o
[[to]] [[impress]]. They never noticed one much, they were so busy with other things,
[[focusing]] on other famous people, unable to have or express kind feelings, or just working too hard. There
[[was]] no bedtime stories and one’s school reports weren’t the subject of praise and admiration. That’s why one dreams that one day the world will pay attenti
[[will have to]] admire us too.
문항.explanation: 뒤에 오는 주어가 복수 bedtime stories이므로 There were로 써야 한다.

문항.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 문장과 의미가 통하면서 어법상 옳은 것은?
body: <보기> Museum rules let visitors not touch the
works, but many people forget it.
choices: Touching the works is let by museum rules, but many people forget it.
Visitors are let to touch the works by museum rules, but many people forget it.
Museum rules that nobody know allow visitors not to touch the works.
Visitors are let not touching the works by museum rules, but many people forget it.
Visitors aren't allowed to touch the works by museum rules, but many people forget it.
문항.explanation: let은 수동태로 쓰지 않고 be allowed to로 바꿔 쓴다.

문항.포인트: It is said that ~ = 주어 + is said to ~
문항.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 문장과 의미가 통하면서 어법상 옳은 것을 [[모두]]고르시오. (2개)
body: <보기> People say that a healthy diet is essential.
choices: It is said a healthy diet essential.
It is said that a healthy diet is essential.
It is said that a healthy diet to be essential.
A healthy diet are said that be essential.
A healthy diet is said to be essential.
문항.explanation: 가주어 It을 쓰거나 that절의 주어를 문장의 주어로 올려 to부정사로 잇는다.

문항.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 문장과 의미가 통하면서 어법상 옳은 것은?
body: <보기> Planting trees made the park much cooler.
choices: Planting trees, the park was made much cooler.
The park was made much cooler by planting trees.
The park was made much by planting trees cooler.
Much cooler was made the park by planting trees.
The park was made to much cooler by planting trees.
문항.explanation: 목적어를 주어로 보내고 목적격보어는 그대로 뒤에 둔다.

문항.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 [[틀린]]것은?
choices: His calm attitude [[was connected with]] his long training.
I hope more chances will [[be offered for]] you.
Owen [[is considered]] the kindest boy in the class.
Students [[were heard talking]] loudly in the hallway after the bell.
She [[was made to follow]] the schedule because the rules were strict.
문항.explanation: offer는 3형식에서 to를 쓰므로 be offered to you로 써야 한다.

문항.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 문장과 의미가 통하면서 어법상 옳은 것을 [[모두]]고르시오. (2개)
body: <보기> She told us the exact date of the trip.
choices: The exact date was told to us of the trip.
We were told the exact date of the trip by her.
The exact date of the trip was told of us by her.
The exact date of the trip was told to us by her.
We were told that the exact date was decided with her.
문항.explanation: 간접목적어를 주어로 하거나, 직접목적어를 주어로 하고 to us를 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 문장과 의미가 통하면서 어법상 옳은 것은?
body: <보기> The guards made the noisy visitors leave
the hall, watching them closely.
choices: Noise made the guards leave the hall and watch the visitors.
Leaving the hall was made for the noisy visitors by the guards.
Noisy visitors were made leaving the hall by the guards and watched closely.
Being watched closely by them, noisy visitors were made to leave the hall by the guards.
Noisy visitors were made to leave the hall by the guards, watching them closely.
문항.explanation: 사역동사의 수동태에서는 목적격보어가 to부정사로 바뀌고, 분사구문의 주어가 방문객이므로 수동형으로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 주어진 우리말을 올바르게 영작한 것은?
body: <보기> 두 명의 아이가 교실에서 뛰어나오는 것이
보였다.
choices: Two children saw run out of the classroom.
Two children saw to run out of the classroom.
Two children was seen to run out of the classroom.
Two children were seen run out of the classroom.
Two children were seen to run out of the classroom.
문항.explanation: 주어가 복수이므로 were seen, 목적격보어는 to부정사로 바뀐다.

문항.prompt: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
body: <보기> This report ________ for the meeting since
last week.
choices: wrote
was written
was writing
has written
has been written
문항.explanation: 지난주부터 지금까지 이어지는 일이고 보고서는 쓰이는 쪽이므로 현재완료 수동태로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 올바르게 영작한 것은?
body: <보기> 그 규칙은 오랫동안 지켜져 왔다.
choices: The rule kept for a long time.
The rule was kept for a long time.
The rule has kept for a long time.
The rule was had kept for a long time.
The rule has been kept for a long time.
문항.explanation: ‘~되어 왔다’는 「has been + 과거분사」로 나타낸다.

문항.prompt: 주어진 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
body: <보기> People started to repair the bridge two
months ago and they still repair it.
choices: The bridge is repaired for two months.
The bridge has been repaired for two months.
People have been repaired the bridge for two months.
People are repairing the bridge for two months.
The bridge has being repaired for two months.
문항.explanation: 두 달 전부터 지금까지 이어지고 다리는 고쳐지는 쪽이므로 현재완료 수동태로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
body: <보기> The construction ____________ since last
spring.
choices: stopped
was stoped
has stopped
been stopped
has been stopped
문항.explanation: 공사는 멈춰진 쪽이고 지난봄부터 이어지므로 has been stopped로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
body: <보기> 나는 그 그림이 단 하루 만에 그 화가에 의해
그려졌다는 것을 들었다.
= I heard that the painting ________ by the artist
in just one day.
choices: was paint
has painted
had painted
has been painted
had been painted
문항.explanation: 들은 때보다 그려진 것이 앞선 일이므로 과거완료 수동태로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 밑줄 친 부분을 수동태로 올바르게 바꾼 것은?
body: <보기> She found out that [[someone had opened]]
[[her letter]].
choices: her letter was opened
her letter had been opened
her letter had opened by someone
someone was opened by her letter
someone had been opened by her letter
문항.explanation: 목적어를 주어로 보내고 「had been + 과거분사」로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 주어진 문장과 의미가 같도록, 밑줄 친 문장을 주어로 하여 올바르게 영작한 것은?
body: <보기> The city had offered [[free bus rides for]]
[[students]] until last year.
choices: Free bus rides for students offered by the city until last year.
Free bus rides for students was offered by the city until last year.
Free bus rides for students been offered by the city until last year.
Free bus rides for students has been offered by the city until last year.
Free bus rides for students had been offered by the city until last year.
문항.explanation: 능동태가 과거완료이므로 수동태도 「had been + 과거분사」로 쓴다.

문항.포인트: be asked to + 동사원형과 stop + 동명사
문항.prompt: 다음 우리말과 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
body: <보기> 내 동생은 밤 10시 넘어서 TV를 보지 않도록
요청받았다.
→ My brother was asked ________________ after 10.
choices: to watch TV
not to watching TV
to stop to watch TV
to stop watching TV
not to stop watching TV
문항.explanation: ‘~하는 것을 그만두다’는 stop + 동명사이고, 요청받은 내용은 to부정사로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
body: <보기> I saw the tall man running in the park.
→ The tall man _________________ in the park.
choices: saw me run
saw me running
was seen to run
were seen to run
was seen to running
문항.explanation: 주어가 단수이므로 was seen을 쓰고 뒤에는 to부정사를 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은?
body: <보기> The classes ________________ because of
the heavy snow.
choices: canceled
has canceled
haven’t canceled
have been canceled
hasn’t been canceled
문항.explanation: 수업은 취소되는 쪽이고 주어가 복수이므로 have been canceled로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장을 수동태로 알맞게 바꾼 것은?
body: <보기> My father has taught me chess since I
was ten.
choices: Chess has taught my father since I was ten.
Chess has been taught by me since I was ten.
I have taught my father chess since I was ten.
I have been taught chess by my father since I was ten.
Chess and I have been taught by my father since I was ten.
문항.explanation: 간접목적어 me를 주어로 하면 「have been taught + 직접목적어」의 형태가 된다.

문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 단어로 가장 알맞은 것은?
body: <보기>
(1) The bridge ________ been repaired since last
winter.
(2) The wall ________ been painted by me for
more than 3 weeks.
choices: is
has
will
have
is have
문항.explanation: 두 문장 모두 주어가 단수이므로 has been + 과거분사로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은?
body: <보기> His shoes had already been _________
tightly, so it took him a while to take them off.
choices: tie
tied
tying
to tie
to tied
문항.explanation: had been 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 tied를 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
body: <보기> They had canceled the concert due to the
storm.
→ The concert had _______________ due to the
storm.
choices: been canceled
been canceling
canceled
be canceling
be canceled
문항.explanation: had 뒤에 been + 과거분사를 써서 과거완료 수동태로 나타낸다.

문항.prompt: 다음 우리말과 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
body: <보기> 내가 도착했을 때, 그 방은 그때까지 정리되어져
있었다.
→ When I arrived, the room ______________ then.
choices: had tidied
had been tidying
has been tidied
had been tidied
had been being tidied
문항.explanation: 도착한 때보다 앞서 끝난 일이고 방은 정리되는 쪽이므로 had been tidied로 쓴다.
